name: add_blocker
description: Make a Ticket wait on another Ticket in this Project (any Spec) until that one is Done; a link that would form a cycle is rejected. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

blocker.description: The Ticket it waits on. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

ticket.description: The Ticket that waits. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: add_labels
description: Add Labels to a Spec or Ticket, leaving its other Labels alone.

target.description: The Spec or Ticket. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: approve
description: Approve a Draft Ticket you have finished defining, moving it to Ready so it can be claimed. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

name: cancel
description: Cancel a Draft or Ready Ticket by naming the Replacements that take over its work; anything it blocked then waits on them. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

replacements.description: The Tickets taking over its work (at least one). IDs: <key>-<n> or <n>.

ticket.description: The Ticket to cancel. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: claim
description: Claim the next Ready Ticket (or the one named, or the next in a Spec); returns a Claim ID and the Ticket, or ticket null when none. Claiming a Ticket this session already holds, with its session_id, returns the same Claim.

resume_command.description: The command that resumes your session from working_dir, shown to the human as is. Without one the human is shown claude --resume <session_id>.

session_id.description: Your session ID, shown to the human for resuming you.

spec.description: Claim the next Ticket in this Spec. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

ticket.description: Claim this Ticket. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

working_dir.description: The directory you work in, where the human runs the resume command. A hook usually fills it in for you.

name: comment
description: Comment on any Ticket, even one another agent holds; no Claim ID is needed. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

name: create_spec
description: Create a Spec, the description of a piece of work delivered through one or more Tickets; returns an acknowledgement with its ID, or the Spec with full.

full.description: Return the whole Spec instead of the acknowledgement.

name: create_ticket
description: Create a Ticket in a Spec, as Draft (the default) or Ready. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

blocked_by.description: Tickets it waits on until they are Done. IDs: <key>-<n> or <n>.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

spec.description: The Spec it belongs to. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

tags.description: Tags to set on it, as {key: value}; checked as set_tags checks them, so effort must be a valid level.

name: defer
description: Defer a Ready Ticket that isn't ready back to Draft, with the reason stored as a comment. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

name: edit_spec
description: Edit a Spec's title or body; a body given replaces the old one whole, and the old text is kept in its edit history. Returns an acknowledgement naming the changed fields, or the Spec with full.

body.description: The new body in Markdown, replacing the old one whole.

full.description: Return the whole Spec instead of the acknowledgement.

name: edit_ticket
description: Edit a Ticket's title or description; the old text is kept in its edit history. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

description.description: The new description in Markdown, replacing the old one whole.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

name: find_specs
description: Find this Project's Specs with their State summaries; finished Specs are left out unless finished is true.

labels.description: Only Specs with all of these Labels.

requirements.description: Only Requirements: Specs with Stage Tickets.

tags.description: Only Specs with all of these Tags, as {key: value}.

title.description: Only Specs whose title contains this text.

name: find_tickets
description: Find this Project's Tickets in claim order; every filter given must match. Each row carries needs_me_reason when the Ticket waits on the human, the same as get_ticket. With full, each is the whole Ticket as get_ticket returns it (the default parts, brief), in place of the row.

claimable.description: Only Tickets that are (true) or aren't (false) claimable.

full.description: Return each Ticket as get_ticket does, in place of the row.

labels.description: Only Tickets with all of these Labels.

spec.description: Only Tickets in this Spec. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

state.description: Only Tickets in one of these States.

tags.description: Only Tickets with all of these Tags, as {key: value}.

title.description: Only Tickets whose title contains this text.

name: finish
description: Finish a claimed Ticket into In Review with a summary: what was done, where (branch or commit; with several Repositories, the others' in repositories), and what to check. Returns an acknowledgement with the next step, or the Ticket with full.

branch.description: The branch the work is on, if any. Accepting work on a branch moves it to Accepted, to land once merged.

commit.description: The branch's head commit, if any.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

recommendation.description: Required on a spec Stage only: implement or split.

repositories.description: With several Repositories: each other Repository you committed in. branch and commit stay the Home Repository's.

branch.description: The branch the work is on there.

summary.description: What was done, where, and what the reviewer should check, in Markdown.

name: get_import_guide
description: Get how to map a repository's .scratch/ folder into one import payload, and how to present the plan to the human.

name: get_spec
description: Get a Spec with its body, a count of its Tickets per State, and its Tickets as find_tickets rows; parts (body, tickets, edits, outline) and sections (heading texts) read less and add the body's outline, each heading with its Section's size in bytes; parts ["outline"] alone is the cheapest read; sections alone return only the body.

parts.description: Only these parts, any of body, tickets, edits and outline; all three when left out, or only body with sections.

sections.description: Only the body's Sections under these headings, matched case-insensitively at any level.

name: get_stage_guide
description: Get a Stage Guide again (claim returns it): what a Ticket of that Stage produces and how to finish it.

stage.description: The guide's name: the Ticket's Stage Label without stage:, map-<type> for a Wayfinder Label wayfinder:<type>, prototype, retro, or implementation when it has none of these.

name: get_ticket
description: Get one Ticket: its description, State, Blockers, past Claims and how each ended, every Failure Report and every comment; left_out counts what it leaves out, and parts (claims, failure_reports, comments, rounds, moves, edits) asks for exactly those.

parts.description: Only these parts, any of claims, failure_reports, comments, rounds, moves and edits; claims, failure_reports and comments when left out.

name: get_workflow
description: Get the whole workflow (every State, action, who may take it, what it requires) and how to work a Ticket; call it before working one.

name: give_up
description: Give a claimed Ticket back to Ready when nothing is wrong but you can't finish it, with a note on how far you got. Ends your Claim; then stop working this Ticket. Returns an acknowledgement with the next step, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

note.description: How far you got and why you are stopping, in Markdown.

name: import
description: Import a whole .scratch/ folder mapped as get_import_guide says; run with dry_run first and wait for the human's go-ahead.

dry_run.description: Check everything and return the plan, writing nothing.

source.description: The spec.md, map.md or folder path from the repository root.

tags.description: Tags as {key: value}; source is set from source.

tickets.description: Every Ticket, in folder then file-number order.

blocked_by.description: Sources of the Tickets it waits on, in this payload.

comment.description: A reason to keep as a comment (wontfix, Deferred).

description.description: The description, in Markdown, without the header lines that became State, Blockers, Labels or Tags.

replacements.description: For a Cancelled Ticket, sources of the Tickets that take over its work.

source.description: The file's path from the repository root.

tags.description: Tags as {key: value}; source is set from source.

name: land
description: Land a Ticket: once its work is merged into the base of one of its Changed Repositories, record the commit that put it there; once it has landed in every one, it moves from Accepted (or In Review) to Done. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

commit.description: The commit that put the work into the base, such as the merge commit.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

repository.description: The Repository Name whose base it landed in; the Home Repository when left out.

name: pick_up_answers
description: Pick up the answers to your latest Round on an Answered Ticket you hold, moving it back to In Progress; returns the Round and comments since.

name: post_round
description: Ask the human a Round of Questions on a Ticket you hold, in one write; it moves to Needs Answer and you keep the Claim. Returns an acknowledgement with the Round number and the next step, or only those with full.

full.description: Return only the Round number and the next step instead of the acknowledgement.

questions.description: The Questions, each with a title, a body and an optional recommended answer.

body.description: The Question in Markdown, with any choices as prose.

recommended.description: Your recommended answer, if you have one.

session_id.description: Your session ID, shown to the human for resuming you.

name: remove_blocker
description: Remove a Blocker from a Ticket. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

blocker.description: The Blocker to remove. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

ticket.description: The Ticket that waits. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: remove_labels
description: Remove Labels from a Spec or Ticket, leaving its other Labels alone.

target.description: The Spec or Ticket. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: remove_tags
description: Remove Tags from a Spec or Ticket by key.

target.description: The Spec or Ticket. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: report_failure
description: Report a failure when nothing the human can answer will unblock you: what broke, why, what to fix and where the work stands. Ends your Claim; then stop working this Ticket. Returns an acknowledgement with the next step, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

what_broke.description: A headline plus the symptom, in Markdown.

what_to_fix.description: What has to change before this Ticket can go on, in Markdown.

where_work_stands.description: Where the work stands: branch, commits, what is done, in Markdown.

name: send_back
description: Send an Accepted Ticket back to Ready when its branch can't land, such as on a merge conflict, with a note naming the base commit and the conflicting files. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

note.description: Why it can't land: the base commit and the conflicting files, in Markdown.

name: set_session
description: Record the session now working your Claim, and how to get back into it, so the human can resume it. A hook usually fills session_id in for you. Returns an acknowledgement with the Ticket's State, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

resume_command.description: The command that resumes your session from working_dir. Left out, the recorded one stays.

working_dir.description: The directory you work in now. Left out, the recorded one stays.

name: set_tags
description: Set Tags on a Spec or Ticket, overwriting only the keys named; keys are lowercase [a-z0-9._-], values one non-empty line.

target.description: The Spec or Ticket. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: submit_map
description: Submit a Map: its text becomes a Spec labelled wayfinder:map (titled with the first line, with the Map's empty sections) and one Ready Charting Ticket for a Factory to work; returns their acknowledgements, or the Spec and Ticket with full.

draft.description: Save the Charting Ticket as Draft instead of Ready, so nothing is claimed until the human moves it to Ready.

full.description: Return the whole Spec and Charting Ticket instead of their acknowledgements.

text.description: The Map's text, in Markdown; its first line becomes the Spec's title.

name: submit_prototype
description: Submit a Prototype on any Spec: a Ready Ticket labelled prototype, titled "Prototype: <first line>" with the text as its description, for a Factory to build on a local branch that never lands; returns its acknowledgement, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

spec.description: The Spec the Prototype is on. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

text.description: What to prototype and the question it answers, in Markdown; its first line becomes the title.

name: submit_requirement
description: Submit a Requirement: its text becomes a Spec (titled with the first line) with three Ready Stage Tickets, grilling, then spec, then tickets, for a Factory to work; with map, a finished Map's Decisions replace the grilling Stage. Returns their acknowledgements, or the Spec and Tickets with full.

draft.description: Save the Spec's Tickets as Draft instead of Ready, so nothing is claimed until the human moves them to Ready; not with map.

full.description: Return the whole Spec and Stage Tickets instead of their acknowledgements.

map.description: A Map with no unfinished Tickets to write the Spec from: the Requirement gets only the spec and tickets Stages, and a map Tag naming the Map. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

skip_grilling.description: Straight to Spec: create no grilling Stage, so the spec Stage is written from the text alone. Can't be given with map.

text.description: The Requirement's text, in Markdown; its first line becomes the Spec's title.

name: submit_retro
description: Start a Retro on finished work, a Done or Cancelled Ticket or a Finished Spec: a Ready Ticket labelled retro on the Project's Retros Spec, titled "Retro: <target title>", whose description lists every Claim on the work to read; returns its acknowledgement, or the Ticket with full.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

note.description: What the human wants the Retro to look at, in Markdown; optional.

target.description: The finished Ticket or Spec the Retro looks back on. An ID: <key>-<n> or <n>.

name: submit_small_change
description: Submit a Small Change: a Ready implementation Ticket on the Project's Small Changes Spec, titled with the text's first line and carrying the text as its description, which a Factory builds and lands on its own; returns its acknowledgement, or the Ticket with full.

draft.description: Save the Ticket as Draft instead of Ready, so nothing is claimed until the human moves it to Ready.

full.description: Return the whole Ticket instead of the acknowledgement.

text.description: The change to make, in Markdown; its first line becomes the Ticket's title.
